ex.es: Si empieza a llover, cancelamos el picnic.
ex.en: If it starts raining, we'll cancel the picnic.

ex.es: ¡Qué guapa estás hoy! ¿Vas a una fiesta?
ex.en: You look really pretty today! Are you going to a party?

ex.es: Mi papá era muy guapo de joven.
ex.en: My dad was very good-looking when he was young.

notes: Two small fixes: a stilted 'Empieza a llover' replaced with a natural conditional; 'guapa' translation tightened to the glossed meaning. All other examples accurate and natural.
